dialog.english: Guys!
It's been a while!
Ah! It's the princess, ribbit!
Save us, ribbit!
Everyone's all tired out...
What on earth is going on?

It's our lord's karaoke contest,
tama.
dialog.translation:
Es el karaoke de
nuestro amo, tama.

dialog.english: What do you mean?

We're happy that the princess's
song woke up our lord, ribbit.
dialog.translation:
Nos alegra que su canción
despertara a nuestro
amo, croac.

dialog.english:
Our lord has been singing karaoke
from dawn to dusk, and we can't 
sleep from the sound, ribbit.
dialog.translation:
Nuestro amo canta karaoke
del amanecer al anochecer,
y no podemos dormir, croac.

dialog.english:
So we need the prinshess's help,
tama!
Huh?! Me?

We want you to make him lose his
confidence by beating him cold in
a karaoke contest, tama!
dialog.translation:
¡Queremos que le hagas perder
la confianza venciéndolo en
un concurso de karaoke, tama!

dialog.english: But if she does that...

Won't he start focusing *more*
on practicing karaoke?
dialog.translation:
¿No se centrará AÚN MÁS en
practicar karaoke?

dialog.english: You're right, ribbit.
That's not good, ribbit.
I got an idea, tama!
What is it, ribbit?

I found the manual to make that
medicine, tama!
dialog.translation:
¡Encontré el manual para
hacer esa medicina, tama!

dialog.english: Really, ribbit?

Hey, I don't get what's going on
here...
dialog.translation:
Oye, no entiendo qué pasa
aquí...

dialog.english: What's this medicine?

In this castle, there's a recipe
for medicine to change the volume
of TonosamaGekomon's voice.
dialog.translation:
En este castillo hay una
receta para bajar el volumen
de la voz de ShogunGekomon.

dialog.english:
Huh... that's an interesting
medicine.

If we make this medicine, we might
be able to soften our lord's
voice, ribbit.
dialog.translation:
Si hacemos esta medicina,
podríamos suavizar la voz
de nuestro amo, croac.

dialog.english:
Then TonosamaGekomon can enjoy
his karaoke, and you can sleep in
peace!
dialog.translation:
¡Así ShogunGekomon disfruta
su karaoke, y vosotros
dormís en paz!

dialog.english:
Prinshess, we'd like you to help
us make this medicine, tama!
dialog.translation:
¡Princesa, queremos que nos
ayudes a hacer esta
medicina, tama!

dialog.english:
Okay! After all that trouble I
gave you earlier, I'll have to
work hard for you guys!
dialog.translation:
¡Vale! ¡Tras los problemas
que os causé antes, me
esforzaré por vosotros!

dialog.english: Hooraaaaaaaaay! Hooraaaaaaaaaaay!

So the materials are hidden
here...

We have to get three materials in
all...

I wonder why they divided it up
and stored it in different places?
dialog.translation:
¿Por qué lo dividirían y
guardarían en sitios
distintos?

dialog.english:
Bet it's like how you'd separate a
bank book and seal.
dialog.translation:
Debe de ser como separar
una libreta y su sello.

dialog.english:
I see, so they're valuable
materials.

(Wait, he could understand that
analogy!?)

Anyway, we just need to get all
the materials and give 'em to the
Gekomon.
dialog.translation:
En fin, solo hay que
conseguir los materiales y
dárselos a los Gekomon.

dialog.english: Obtained a medicine material!

Two materials left! Keep at it,
Mimi!
Obtained a medicine material!
One material left! One more, Mimi!
Obtained a medicine material!

Now we have to give these
materials to the Gekomon.
dialog.translation:
Ahora hay que darles estos
materiales a los Gekomon.

dialog.english: Finished, tama!
We did it, ribbit!

It's thanks to the princess,
ribbit!
Isn't that great, Mimi?

Now we just have to get
TonosamaGekomon to drink this.
dialog.translation:
Ahora solo hay que hacer
que ShogunGekomon se beba
esto.

dialog.english: Ugh...
No point in getting mad, Mimi.

Making the medicine is one thing,
but we haven't thought about how
to get him to drink it...
dialog.translation:
Hacer la medicina es una
cosa, pero no pensamos en
cómo dársela...

dialog.english: This is shameful, ribbit.

Our lord is fussy about taste,
ribbit. We can't mix it in his
food, ribbit.
dialog.translation:
Nuestro amo es quisquilloso
con el sabor, croac. No
podemos mezclarla, croac.

dialog.english:
We'll have to force him to drink
it after all...

Why am *I* the one who has to do
this?
dialog.translation:
¿Por qué tengo que ser YO
quien lo haga?

dialog.english: Go for it, Mimi!
Fight, prinshess!
Ah! G-good morning...
Mimi! Run!
So *that's* how it goes?!

I didn't know that I was causing
everyone trouble, ribbit.
dialog.translation:
No sabía que causaba
problemas a todos, croac.

dialog.english:
I'll just keep it from morning to
evening, ribbit.
dialog.translation:
Solo cantaré de la mañana
a la noche, croac.

dialog.english:
We're indebted to you, princess!
Ribbit!
Thank you, ribbit!

Thank you! Now don't get into any
more disputes, okay?
All right then, byyyyyye~!

So the materials are hidden
here...

Three materials left! Keep at it,
Mimi!

So the materials are hidden
here...

Two materials left! Keep at it,
Mimi!

So the materials are hidden
here...

One material left! Keep at it,
Mimi!

Now we just have to give these
materials to the Gekomon.
dialog.translation:
Ahora hay que dar estos
materiales a los Gekomon.

dialog.english:
We don't have enough materials,
ribbit. We can't make the medicine
with this, ribbit...
dialog.translation:
No tenemos materiales
suficientes, croac. No
podemos hacerla así, croac...

dialog.english:
I know, but I couldn't really find
them...
dialog.translation:
Lo sé, pero no logré
encontrarlos...

dialog.english:
We need the princess to pull this
off, ribbit!
dialog.translation:
¡Necesitamos que la
princesa lo consiga, croac!

dialog.english:
It's okay! I'll figure it out. I
have three left.
dialog.translation:
¡Tranquilos! Ya me las
apaño. Me quedan tres.

dialog.english:
It's okay! I'll figure it out. I
have two left.
dialog.translation:
¡Tranquilos! Ya me las
apaño. Me quedan dos.

dialog.english:
It's okay! I'll figure it out. I
have one left.
dialog.translation:
¡Tranquilos! Ya me las
apaño. Me queda uno.

dialog.english:
Oh, these are all the materials!
We can make the medicine!
dialog.translation:
¡Oh, son todos los
materiales! ¡Podemos hacer
la medicina!
